answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36713 Country: India Title: Can I give on rent my shop for ATM to a bank? Question: Can I give on rent my shop for ATM to a bank? Answer ID: 36713 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 335/335/M=1433) It is allowable. However it is better not to give it. وقالا : لا ينبغي ذلك لأنه إعانة على المعصية (شامي) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
